title: The derivative is the gradient
caption: For x = 5t² − 2t³ the velocity is v = dx/dt = 10t − 6t². At t = 1 s the position is 3 m and the tangent (dashed) has gradient v = 4 m s⁻¹. The acceleration there is a = dv/dt = 10 − 12t = -2 m s⁻²: the curve is already bending over.
alt: Graph of x = 5t^2 − 2t^3, rising to a maximum near 1.7 seconds, with the tangent at t = 1 second having gradient 4 metres per second.
description: Position x in metres against time t in seconds, 0 to 2.5 s.
At t = 1 s the curve passes through x = 3 m. The dashed tangent there rises 4 m for each second: v = 10(1) − 6(1)² = 4 m s⁻¹.
The curve peaks at t = 5/3 s, where v = 0, and then falls back. The curve is concave down at t = 1 s because a = 10 − 12(1) = -2 m s⁻² is negative.
